messages:
julia: acme just pinged — their private deployment stopped showing tenant-level graphs/usage after last-night's mTLS rollout. Console shows flat lines for acme-420, everything else looks normal.

acme: Yep. API calls succeed from our VPC, tokens accepted, but Console and billing show zero. We have examples if you need.

mike: I'm seeing a flood of 502/503s from rtr-private around 2029-11-04 02:12-02:20 UTC. Might be TLS handshake churn from the new sidecar.

sara: Can you curl it from inside your network and paste request headers? We suspect header sanitization.

acme: Quick repro:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer tenant-token-acme420" -H "X-Tenant-ID: acme-420" https://internal-router.redwood/v1/health
```

acme: Response 200, but gateway logs show X-Tenant-ID missing when forwarded to telemetry-ingest.

ops-bot (eng-ops-bot): [alert] telemetry-pipeline spike: 503s on rtr-private-ingress (02:11-02:19 UTC) — upstream TLS handshake failures.

mike: Pulled proxy trace for that request id, snippet: 
```
proxy: recv headers: Authorization: Bearer tenant-token-acme420, X-Tenant-ID: acme-420
proxy: mTLS sidecar: terminate TLS, inject Authorization: Bearer svc-account-rotated
proxy: forward to backend: Authorization: Bearer svc-account-rotated
proxy: forward to backend: (X-Tenant-ID) not present
```

sara: Aha — sidecar rewrites/rotates Authorization and is dropping customer headers by default. Telemetry agent tags by X-Tenant-ID, so dropped header => untagged metrics => graphs show nothing.

julia: Was there a config change? I remember we added header-sanitization to the mTLS sidecar.

infra-sre: We deployed ingress-controller v2.3.1 at 02:10 UTC with stricter header sanitization. Default is ingress.preserve_customer_headers=false. We didn't add an exception for private VPCs.

mike: Short term: flip preserve flag for affected CR and restart ds/mtls-sidecar. Example: 
```
kubectl -n acme set configmap acme-ingress-config --from-literal=ingress.preserve_customer_headers=true
kubectl -n acme rollout restart daemonset/mtls-sidecar
```

sara: Added those commands to the ticket and asked acme to re-run the curl and paste headers after change.

acme: Did it. New request shows X-Tenant-ID preserved. Console metrics started backfilling within ~2 mins. Billing charts catching up.

julia: Good. Let's add a release note and a follow-up to make preserve_customer_headers default=true for private deployments or at least document the behavior prominently.

infra-sre: Filing ENG-8741 to add a safe default, cluster-level override, and an e2e test that ensures telemetry headers survive mTLS termination.

mike: Postmortem note: root cause = header-sanitization in mTLS rollout that dropped X-Tenant-ID and rotated Authorization, breaking tenant tagging for telemetry. Impact = missing per-tenant Console metrics and billing lag. Remediation = enable header passthrough + restart sidecar. Prevent = docs, default exception for private VPCs, and CI e2e.

sara: I'll also add a Console alert: if a tenant has >0 tokens and zero metrics for 5 minutes, show a warning pointing to ingress header config.

acme: Appreciate the quick help — resolved on our side. :pray:

julia: Marking thread resolved. Will follow up on ENG ticket and docs. :white_check_mark:
